judge_stance: Neutral referee. For each of the 12 answers I decide whether the specialist file genuinely supports it, classify any defect (gap|contradiction|stale|overclaim|untagged|scope|ok), cite the EXACT spec location as evidence, propose a minimal concrete fix, and set a disposition (apply_now|propose|watch|none). apply_now is reserved for high-confidence, in-scope, MECHANICAL corrections that still pass build.sh (fix a stale figure, add a missing tag, defer to the dominance owner, soften an over-claim). Anything needing new research/measurement/judgment is 'propose'; already-mitigated or low-severity is 'watch'. Honesty binding respected: the three governing blockers (Ludhiana knit+LINK rate, live blended CAC, forward India duty) stay [UNKNOWN]; off-paper is mechanism-not-accusation; cotton duty ~16.5% never ~7%; no fabrication to close a gap.

verdicts.evidence: role ('The single viability test is contribution margin after CAC (LTV:CAC > ~3), NOT gross margin'); boundaries[2] ('the per-article landed-cost stack, the contribution-after-CAC P&L and the duty/de-minimis go/no-go math are owned by T9 unit economics and consumed here only as the AOV/CAC-headroom precondition'); conflicts_and_dominance[0] ('contribution-after-CAC dominates gross margin in any viability call'); escalation_triggers[3][4] (defer hardened contribution/floor to T9); decision_procedure steps 3 & 8. Cross-checked router.json dominance_rules[viability] (unit_economics + DECISION_MEMO govern) and neutralize_gate N7 and DECISION_MEMO section 1/4 (dead-as-first-drawn; one inverted config; inventory cash FORBIDDEN until G1-G4; GATED-conditional-GO). Those exact tokens live in router.json + DECISION_MEMO, NOT in brand_market.specialist.json — grep of the spec finds no 'GATED', no 'G1'/'G2'/'G3'/'G4', no 'conditional-GO'. The answerer's own gap_note admits this and it is confirmed true.
verdicts.defect_detail: The spec correctly refuses the viability verdict, defers the P&L to T9, and applies the contribution-after-CAC discipline (no scope-creep into unit_economics' lane, no N7-violating naive 'this closes the math' yes), so the answer is faithful. But the specialist file gives the answerer no in-file hook to carry the mandatory GATED-conditional-GO posture and the four-hard-gates enumeration while deferring — it must import N7/DECISION_MEMO from the brain. Under the routed brain this is functionally fine (the router runs N7 on every answer), so severity is med not high: a self-sufficiency gap, not a wrong answer. This is the exact mirror of the mfg_economics Q1 finding.
verdicts.proposed_fix: Add a short pointer clause to boundaries[2] or decision_procedure step 8 such as: 'when a viability question is in scope, defer the go/no-go to unit_economics + the DECISION_MEMO and carry its GATED-conditional-GO posture — dead as first drawn, exactly one inverted config (A3-led + bundles to AOV ~$120-150, organic-led) closes the math, inventory cash forbidden until G1-G4 pass, live blended CAC [UNKNOWN] the single tie-breaker.' Pure pointer to existing brain content; invents no number; defers to the viability owner; mechanical and build-safe.

summary.material_findings: Three med-severity GAPs, none a wrong or fabricated answer — all self-sufficiency/surfacing holes the answerer honestly reported: BMQ1 (the spec relies on router.json/DECISION_MEMO to supply the mandatory GATED-conditional-GO posture and the four hard gates rather than pointing to them in-file when deferring a viability question); BMQ7 (the channel ladder leans on organic AI-design content as the load-bearing CAC-suppressing engine but the spec never labels it a copyable EDGE-not-a-moat nor ties organic-reach conversion to gate G7/G1, risking an over-read of the organic engine as durable); BMQ10 (the deferral to the T9 live floor is clean but the spec does not name that the T9 floor is itself blocked on the [UNKNOWN] knit+LINK rate, G2, so the full [UNKNOWN] chain is not surfaced). Plus two low untagged labeling-tightness items already 90% covered by surrounding discipline: BMQ2 (the $35 / $45-75 CAC endpoints carry no worked derivation basis) and BMQ9 ('near-zero CAC' seed descriptor rides as prose without an inline [ESTIMATE] tag). All three apply_now fixes are pure build-safe pointers to existing brain content (a gate reference, a carried_correction, an [UNKNOWN]-chain pointer); none invents a number.
summary.convergence_note: NOT dry. Three med findings survive verification (BMQ1 GATED-posture pointer, BMQ7 EDGE-not-a-moat + organic-conversion gate pointer, BMQ10 knit+LINK-G2 chain pointer). Unlike the mfg_economics round, all three surviving med findings are build-safe MECHANICAL pointers to existing brain content and are eligible for apply_now — no authored research/measurement/judgment is required to close them, so they are corrections rather than a substantive round-2 research agenda. Per stop_conditions, dry=false; a round 2 questioner (also reading this judgment) would have little surviving weak-spot surface once these three pointers land, so convergence is expected fast. The two low untagged items are watch (basis-writing / cosmetic tag), not blockers.
